characterization_methods: X-ray diffractometer in u–2u mode with Cu–Ka radiation
Hall measurement with the Van der Pauw electrode configuration
Atomic force microscopy (AFM) in noncontact mode
evidence: The film thickness was measured by ellipsometry and cross-section transmission electron microscopy (TEM). The preferred growth direction and crystal structure were examined by X-ray diffractometer in u–2u mode with Cu–Ka radiation and TEM. The film compositions (O/Zn ratio) of the films were qualitatively investigated by an Auger electron spectroscopy (AES) depth profile using an electron beam energy of 5 kV . Depth profiles of the films were examined by secondary ion mass spectrometry (SIMS). The carrier-type, concentrations and electron mobility were measured using a Hall measurement with the Van der Pauw electrode configuration under a magnetic field of 0.5 T at room temperature. The surface roughness of the films was measured by atomic force microscopy (AFM) in noncontact mode with a tip constant of 40 N/m and resonance frequency of 300 kHz.
